# Vendored solver source

These files are the transitive source dependencies of `puzzles/444/solve.ts` from `@cubesmith/scrambler` version 0.15.0, MIT license, copyright 2026 DrSiroukane. The license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

They were extracted without modification from the published package's `dist/index.js.map` `sourcesContent`. The npm tarball has SHA-1 `b42dc0843612e393afba5ea90840b6230eda6b0b`. The package does not export its internal 4×4 solver, so this pinned source copy is maintained separately behind `src/solver/fourByFour/solver.ts`. Updates require review, fresh replay tests, and a license check. Do not edit vendor code as if it were project-owned.
